artifact_formats.snapshot: existing idm_snapshot.read_snapshot JSON actors; integer frame/Actor IDs
artifact_formats.future: existing PredictionState CSV: F0+k, prediction_time_s=k*dt, k=1..H/dt
artifact_formats.clock: CSV frame,simulation_time_s from actual world snapshots, includes origin and every future frame; never generated solely from loop index
artifact_formats.environment: required.environment JSON; equality of map/hash/version/weather/settings/route/external actors/known exogenous information
artifact_formats.physics: JSON {measurement_status:complete_static,unknown_fields:[],actors:{logical:raw physics}}; existing physics_settings normalization for static comparison
artifact_formats.events: JSON {capture_status,frame_start,frame_end,covered_logical_ids,raw_definitions,raw_events,label_status,label_protocol,labels}; raw_events keep event frame/timestamp, pair,kind,original payload and provenance
artifact_formats.registry: JSON {sources:[{source_run_id,split,protocol,code_commit,data_manifest_sha256}]}; one split per Source across all windows; historical source manifests require separate authenticity review

causality.allowed_observed_information: Source prefix frames <= F0 and timestamp <= t0
causality.undeclared_inputs: reject; producer inventory declaration still requires code review
causality.known_future_schedule: only preregistered exogenous information, distinct from observed future

initial_state_policy.candidate_bbox_and_static_physics: semantic equality proposal only; no acceptance rule is approved or applied
initial_state_policy.validator_behavior: record residuals and initial configuration differences only; neither thresholds nor exact equality decide acceptance; scoring and runtime execution always disabled

event_policy.raw_collision_and_near_miss: preserve original detector definition and event frame/time; no inferred labels
event_policy.risk_metrics_require: complete independent annotation, negative windows, all pair/frame coverage, definition and provenance
event_policy.incomplete_labels: trajectory-only contract may retain limitation; risk_detection request rejected
event_policy.disappearance_collision: complete-cohort prototype rejects incomplete trajectory; future censoring contract required
